title: BPW-2026-0439
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0439
ADVISEMENT #1
BOE + BCA
CD 4
APPEAL HEARING – MLADEN BUNTICH CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC. (MBCC)
Recommending the Board:
FIND that MBCC is not entitled to additional compensations for Item No. 1 Type C Soils Differing Site Conditions extra work; Item No. 11 Inspection Demand Issue; Item Nos. 14, 15, 16, and 17 Short Pays; and Item No. 21 Short Pay;
FIND that MBCC’s appeal to the Board of their retention claim to be addressed by the Bureau of Contract Administration (BCA)’s, Office of Contract Compliance at the project acceptance; and
FIND that MBCC shall credit the City of Los Angeles for BCA 82.5 hours for Off-Hour Inspection at $100.00 per hour or $8,250.
(W.O.: SZC13456)
(CONTINUED FROM WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19, 2026)
summary: Appeal hearing decision for MLADEN BUNTICH CONSTRUCTION COMPANY regarding compensation claims.
